identity.title: Advancing MAPF Toward the Real World: A Scalable Multi-Agent Realistic Testbed (SMART)

read_extent: Method III-B/C and task definition; not a reproduction or verification of scalability numbers.
acceptance: No journal-version upgrade; citation is pinned arXiv version. DOI from arXiv metadata retained only as additional provenance.
claim: Uses an ADG execution monitor with RPC completion confirmations and independently operating robot executors. Its stated evaluation task is MAPF path execution, providing prior art for monitored physical execution.
